Toggle.Name: Toggle Research Tech Tree
Toggle.Hint: Open or close the Research Tech Tree window.

Header.NoSelection: No country, facility, or personal research selected

Tooltips.AdvanceWeek: Process this week's research and move to the next week
Tooltips.ResetWeek: Reset the week counter to Week 1
Tooltips.Export: Export all research data as JSON
Tooltips.ImportTree: Add one technology tree without removing existing trees
Tooltips.ExportAll: Export a full backup of all research data
Tooltips.RestoreAll: Replace all research data from a full backup
Tooltips.FitView: Fit all technologies in the view
Tooltips.Import: Import a Research Tech Tree JSON backup
Tooltips.BennyReroll: Spend a Benny and reroll; {count} available
Tooltips.ChooseImage: Choose an image with Foundry's file picker

Entity.NoPlayers: No player users exist in this world.
Entity.ResearchSkillHint: The roll uses this skill from the assigned lead researcher's SWADE character sheet.
Entity.RpOnSuccessHint: A successful SWADE skill roll (total 4 or higher) awards this many research points before raises.
Entity.RpPerRaiseHint: Each raise on the SWADE skill roll awards this many research points.

Technology.ResearchSkillHint: This technology uses this SWADE skill. New technologies begin with the organization's default research skill.

Overview.NoHistory: No weeks have been processed yet.

Tree.Empty: This category has no visible technologies.

Details.EmptyBody: Select or double-click a technology card to inspect its prerequisites, progress, engineers, and modifiers.

Empty.Title: Create your first research organization
Empty.Body: Add a country, research facility, or personal research, then create categories and technologies.
Empty.NoAccessBody: You do not have permission to view any country or research facility.

Modifier.UnlockTechnologyHint: When a technology is selected, this modifier remains passive until that technology is completed.
Modifier.NoneAvailable: Create an entity modifier before linking a technology reward.

Advance.Title: Advance Research Week
Advance.MissingBody: {count} assigned engineers have not rolled this week. Choose how to continue.

Confirm.CreateDemo: Create optional demo data in this empty world?
Confirm.DeleteEntity: Delete this country or facility and all of its technologies, modifiers, and projects?
Confirm.DeleteCategory: Delete this category using the selected technology handling option?
Confirm.DeleteTechnology: Delete this technology and its associated project data?
Confirm.DeleteModifier: Delete this modifier and remove all links to it?
Confirm.CancelProject: Cancel this research project? Its audit record will remain in world data.
Confirm.BennyReroll: Spend one Benny to reroll this research skill? The higher result will be kept.
Confirm.ResetWeek: Reset the counter to Week 1? Weekly rolls for active projects and processed-week history will be cleared; project progress is preserved.

Import.TreeConfirmBody: Add “{name}” with {categories} categories, {technologies} technologies, and {projects} projects? Existing trees will be preserved. Progress, completions, researcher assignments, rolls, and history will be restored. The imported timeline is aligned with the world's live week; a newer file can advance the world week.
Import.ConfirmBody: Replace all current data with {entities} entities, {technologies} technologies, and {projects} projects?
Import.BackupCreated: A backup of the current data has been downloaded first.

Notifications.TreeImportComplete: Added {name} without removing existing technology trees.

Warnings.RollSavedChatFailed: The roll was saved, but its chat message could not be created.
Warnings.WeekSavedChatFailed: The week was processed, but one or more chat messages could not be created.
